name: The Pale March Waygate
descriptionSeed: The waygate the Hub's crossroads opens onto the Pale March. A couple of hours' walk to the fork in the road, and Stillwater's Trouble beyond it.
_connectionsNote: ⛔ CCODE-474 — THE ROAD TO `gen-the-ent-grove` IS GONE, and it is the reason the grove was mis-placed twice. This gate stands beside Millbrook; the grove is at the Crossing's hub, 250° of longitude away, which Silas's own chronicle says plainly ("the Hub's buildings are visible through the trees"). ⚠️ The grove was minted as a `transit` stub whose ONLY road was to this gate, and both later passes then positioned it beside the one neighbour it had — one landing it in `valley` at colatitude 20.2, the other in `manifest_domain` at 74. A single wrong edge was enough to move a place a quarter of the way round the world, twice. ⛑ Removed from BOTH sides in one change, because §99 asserts every road goes both ways and the two-search route would lie without it.
axisVectorNote: Derived from the authored spectrum against world_node_atlas.axisOrder (SNG-180). Disposition — what this place IS. Distinct from world position.
worldPosNote: ⛔ CCODE-416 — PLACED ON ERIK'S WORD (2026-09-06, confirmed 2026-09-18): the March cluster stands beside Millbrook — the Pale March waygate, two hours to the fork on the Ashwarden March road, two hours on to Stillwater's Trouble; the Made Gate's mouth beside the Whistling Woman Post, its watch. SNG-396 had given it an INHERITED position — a room is at its building's coordinates — and this is not a room: it is a place of its own.
provenance: SNG-396 — authored in play, promoted from the saves. Already carried this parent. ⚠️ NOT the Made Gate — a separate record. ⛔ CCODE-416: made a GATE here as reconcile 47 made it in Silas's save on Erik's word (2026-09-06: "SwT is not far from the waygate in the Pale March… we walked a couple hours to a fork") — the promoted copy predated that and carried no `waygate`, and content wins an id clash at load, so the gate Erik walked out of was a plain place to every save, his included.
appearance: A standing stone arch on open ground, its opening holding a still dark plane. Worn ground approaches it from both sides. No structure around it.
